title: Reserve Select Closing Reconciliation Start Day by Bill, TRICARE Reserve Select
content:
**Ledger adjustment ruling - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select, Reserve Select closing reconciliation.**

The day each bill taken in is counted from follows the purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment: where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls inside the period the bill covers, the bill is counted from that effective date; where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls before that period began, the bill is counted from the first day it covers; otherwise the bill is counted from the plan's termination date.

The bills taken in are the monthly bill and the coverage-type adjustment bill of each month of the closing period - the most recently paid coverage month and, where a later coverage month has been billed, that latest-billed month. A monthly bill's period is its whole month; an adjustment bill's period is the days it covers, ending on the last day of its month. The enrollment is the purchaser's own TRICARE Prime enrollment in the Active Duty Service Member tier, read by its status and effective date.

## Applying the ruling (hypothetical: June paid, July billed; June adjustment covers 20 to 30 June; termination date 14 June; enrollment active from 24 June)

| Bill taken in | Period it covers | Counted from |
|---|---|---|
| June monthly bill | 1 to 30 June | 24 June, inside the period |
| June adjustment bill | 20 to 30 June | 24 June, inside the period |
| July monthly bill | 1 to 31 July | 1 July, the effective date being before the period began |

With no applied or active enrollment, every bill would be counted from the termination date, 14 June.
